sections.title: Expected goals pipeline
paragraphs: The engine splits attack into finishing and chance-creation channels (xA / xG-buildup / xG-chain credit all outfield positions), then applies opponent suppression (back line 54%, mid shield 32%, GK 14%) and midfield battle modifiers.
Team A raw attack xG: 2.30 finishing + 0.19 creation = 2.49 before suppression. When Team B defends, suppression factor is 0.833 (DEF 0.52, mid-def 0.40, GK 0.67, transition risk 0.44).
Team B raw attack xG: 2.31 + 0.19 = 2.50. Team A suppression when defending: 0.820 (transition risk 0.25).
Midfield battle multipliers: Team A ×1.000, Team B ×1.000. Net xG edge: Team B by 0.11.

sections.title: Defensive structure & transitions
paragraphs: Team A xGA suppression: 0.721 (base without transition penalty: 0.820). Team B: 0.716 (base 0.797).

Team A fullbacks: Jules Koundé (RB, exposure 0.29), Piero Hincapié (LB, exposure 0.14). Team transition risk 0.253 — high attacking fullbacks increase counter vulnerability when midfield cover is thin.
Team B fullbacks: Achraf Hakimi (RB, exposure 0.38), Nuno Mendes (LB, exposure 0.45). Team transition risk 0.441 — high attacking fullbacks increase counter vulnerability when midfield cover is thin.

Opposition wing threat vs leaky fullbacks: Team A's wide attack gets a +3.4% xG edge (winger threat 0.71, Team B transition risk 0.44). Opposition wing threat vs leaky fullbacks: Team B's wide attack gets a +1.3% xG edge (winger threat 0.60, Team A transition risk 0.25).
